title: Playing with Charlie Christian at Timme Rosenkrantz's apartment
summary: Stewart played a couple of sessions with Charlie Christian at Rosenkrantz's 52nd Street pad and found him down to earth and a beautiful player.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What about Charlie Christian? Did you ever play with Charlie Christian?
Yes, I have been on a couple of sessions with him, yes, back in New York City, when I was working on the Street.
Timmye Rosenkrantz -- you probably heard the name --
-- he used to give little sessions at his pad on 52nd Street, he used to live, and a lot of the cats I met through these sessions, you know. So that's where --
-- I met quite a few of the goodies.
Yeah, because Christian didn't last too
But you got a chance to play with him.
What kind of a guy was he? Because I know one of the stories about him, Benny Goodman was shocked because his dress was so -- he'd wear like green pants and purple shirts and yellow jackets.
Yeah. Well, yes, he was a down-to-earth cat. And he really played. Beautiful.
